newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu's 250,000 bpd topper resumes operations.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu's 250,000 bpd topper resumes operations.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday it has resumed operation of its 250,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Chiba plant, near Tokyo.
The topper, Japan's largest, had been shut since April 30 for maintenance work.

Most secondary facilities at the plant, including a 64,000 bpd vacuum distillation unit, a 42,000 bpd catalytic cracker and a 17,000 bpd catalytic reformer, are scheduled to resume operations next week, a company spokesman said.
Idemitsu plans to shut its 140,000-bpd topper at its Hyogo plant in western Japan for one month from late August for maintenance checks.

Idemitsu has no plans to close its three other CDUs -- the 130,000-bpd topper at Hokkaido in northern Japan, the 160,000-bpd topper at Aichi in central Japan and the 120,000-bpd topper at Tokuyama in western Japan -- this year for turnarounds, he said.
